name: Neapolitan Nightmares
source:
Three dreams of three girls, a wolf who follows them throughout their slumber, a dream that seems to never end.

Three girls, one story.

Three bonds, two friends. 

Three secrets, but no answers.           

A tasty, cold treat. A bitter after taste. Perfect for a sweet dream... or a disgusting nightmare...?

[From [url=https://vanveleca.itch.io/neapolitan-nightmares]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三个女孩的三个梦，一只狼在她们的睡梦中尾随着她们，一个似乎永远不会结束的梦。

三个女孩，一个故事。

三个纽带，两个朋友。

三个秘密，但没有答案。

美味的冷食。后味苦涩。适合甜蜜的梦……还是恶心的噩梦……？

[来自[url=https://vanveleca.itch.io/neapolitan-nightmares]Itch.io[/url]]
